title: Giant skull carried by an excavator and his wife
summary: Tim Alberino tells of Giant skull carried by an excavator and his wife, about c. 1978-1981 at Santa Anastasia, Sardinia, and relays what a named person told them. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: It was so large that he and his wife had to carry it together and they brought it into the church.

plain: Tim Alberino, a guest on Jesse Michels' podcast, passes on another story from Santa Anastasia in Sardinia, an Italian island, from around 1978 to 1981. According to Alberino, a man digging at the site found a giant skull so large that he and his wife had to carry it together, and they brought it into the church. If true, it would be physical evidence that giant people once lived there.
